name: pinky-agentic-plugins
description: Public, generic Claude Code plugins — namespace pc (pinky & co).

plugins.name: pc-core
plugins.description: Generic workspace mechanics: convention replay (apply-pattern), document-to-md, review guidelines, the reviewer agent, and session-hygiene hooks (policy injection, privacy egress, read-cost warning, post-edit lint, output-style reminder).

plugins.name: pc-autodiscovery
plugins.description: Always-on plugin activation: enables the project-scoped plugins matching wherever the session sits, and gates the next tool call while a user-only slash command is still pending. Kept out of pc-core so it works even when pc-core is not loaded.

plugins.name: pc-git
plugins.description: Gitmoji commit workflow, branch strategy, and branch-policy enforcement.

plugins.name: pc-kanban
plugins.description: File-based kanban board mechanics — chantiers, cards, permission guards (careful/freeze/deny), requirements interviews.

plugins.name: pc-snow
plugins.description: Snowflake anti-training-bias knowledge (distilled, provenance tracked) — public.

plugins.name: pc-craft
plugins.description: Generic engineering conventions — code and infra-as-code, zero profile-resolved values.

plugins.name: pc-statusline
plugins.description: Multi-line status line — main-session dashboard (model, context bar, cache hit, cost, rate limits) and a per-subagent row. Pure rendering, zero profile-resolved values.

plugins.name: pc-privacy
plugins.description: Deterministic PII pseudonymization (Presidio + French NLP) as MCP tools, plus an optional local decision-model gate on Read. Detect sensitive columns, then write coherently anonymized copies.

plugins.name: pc-decision
plugins.description: Shared decision-model brick — an MCP client of a local mlx-serve that picks one lettered option and returns its probabilities. Loads no model, runs no daemon, no profile-resolved values.

plugins.name: pc-pypi
plugins.description: Cut a dev pre-release of a PyPI library — preconditions, version bump, push, then stop before the publishing tag for an explicit human go. Zero profile-resolved values.

plugins.name: pc-delegate
plugins.description: Export/reintegrate workflow for delegating work to an agent operating outside Claude Code — export context, reintegrate its results safely.

plugins.name: pc-customize
plugins.description: Appearance and response-style customization: output styles and color themes

plugins.name: pc-rtk
plugins.description: RTK output filtering — rewrites Bash commands to their filtered rtk form before they run, so only compact output enters the context. Needs the rtk binary.

plugins.name: pc-memory
plugins.description: Memory recall at session start — the user sees one summary line per directory level and its stale notes (at least N days old); the model gets the parent levels' indexes only, capped and marked as data. Asks the user before any write into a memory directory, counts per note the sessions that read it, and its `reconcile` skill reviews the notes with the user and applies the approved plan.
